components.name: Callout
components.primarySyntax: :::type size? appearance? family? variant? animation? icon:name?
components.altSyntax: :::wa-callout type size? appearance? family? variant? animation? icon:name?
components.description: Highlight important information with icons and colored styling
components.documentation:
Callouts draw attention to important information. Each type has a different color and icon:
- **info/brand**: Blue with info icon (info is alias for brand)
- **success**: Green with checkmark
- **warning**: Yellow with warning icon
- **danger**: Red with exclamation
- **neutral**: Gray with gear icon

**Sizes:** `xs`, `s`, `m`, `l`, `xl` (Web Awesome 3.x five-step scale) plus the legacy `small`/`medium`/`large` aliases
**Appearances:** accent, filled, outlined, plain, filled-outlined

**Icon appearance:** override the callout icon's `family` (classic, sharp, duotone, sharp-duotone, brands), `variant` font weight (thin, light, regular, solid), and `animation` (beat, fade, beat-fade, bounce, flip, shake, spin, spin-pulse, spin-reverse). Animation needs no Pro kit — e.g. `:::warning shake`.

**Icons:** Use `icon:name` to override the default variant icon (e.g., `icon:shield`, `icon:rocket`)

components.name: Icon
components.description: Standalone Web Awesome icon — inline and decorative, or a block with attributes and an accessible label
components.documentation:
Insert a Web Awesome `<wa-icon>`.

**Inline `$$$name`:** name-only and decorative — use mid-prose (e.g., `the $$$gear icon`). No attributes.

**Block `:::wa-icon name family? variant? animation?`:** the first token is the icon name, followed by optional, order-independent icon attributes. A non-empty block body becomes the icon's accessible `label`; an empty body leaves the icon presentational.

**Icon attributes:**
- **family**: classic, sharp, duotone, sharp-duotone, brands
- **variant** (Font Awesome weight): thin, light, regular, solid
- **animation**: beat, fade, beat-fade, bounce, flip, shake, spin, spin-pulse, spin-reverse

Animation works with any kit; family/variant glyph changes depend on the kit's Font Awesome tier.

components.name: Card
components.description: Container for content with optional header, media, and footer
components.documentation:
Cards are flexible containers that can include:
- **Media**: First image becomes card media
- **Header**: First # heading becomes header
- **Content**: Main text content
- **Footer**: Trailing links become footer buttons

Appearances: outlined (default), filled, filled-outlined, plain, accent
Orientation: vertical (default), horizontal (media and content sit side-by-side)

components.name: Comparison
components.description: Before/after image comparison with draggable slider
components.documentation:
Interactive image comparison slider. Requires exactly 2 images:
- First image: 'before' slot
- Second image: 'after' slot
- Optional position parameter (0-100): Initial slider position

components.name: Carousel
components.description: Image slider or content rotator with navigation
components.documentation:
Carousel for sliding content. Use ~~~ to separate slides.

Parameters:
- **navigation**: Show prev/next arrows
- **pagination**: Show dot indicators
- **loop**: Enable infinite loop
- **autoplay**: Auto-advance slides
- **autoplay-interval:value**: Milliseconds between auto-advances (e.g., 5000; default 3000)
- **mouse-dragging**: Enable drag to slide
- **vertical**: Vertical orientation
- **scroll-hint:value**: Show scroll hint
- **aspect-ratio:value**: e.g., 16/9, 4/3
- **slide-gap:value**: Gap between slides
- **slides-per-page:n**: Slides visible at once
- **slides-per-move:n**: Slides to move at once

components.name: Details
components.primarySyntax: ^^^appearance? icon-placement? disabled? open? name:value? icon:expand:name? icon:collapse:name?
components.altSyntax: :::wa-details appearance? icon-placement? disabled? open? name:value? icon:expand:name? icon:collapse:name?
components.description: Collapsible details/summary component with accordion support
components.example:
^^^icon:expand:plus icon:collapse:minus
Click to expand
>>>
Hidden content here.
^^^
components.documentation:
Collapsible content section. Use >>> to separate summary from details.

Appearances: outlined (default), filled, filled-outlined, plain
Icon placement: end (default), start
Flags:
- **disabled**: Prevents toggling
- **open**: Initially expanded
- **name:value**: Group name for accordion behavior (e.g., name:accordion-1)

**Icons:** Use `icon:expand:name` and `icon:collapse:name` for custom toggle icons (e.g., `icon:expand:plus icon:collapse:minus`)

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Multi-section collapsible container — the grouped sibling of Details, ideal for FAQs and docs sections
components.documentation:
A multi-section collapsible container. The container fence is `//////` (6 slashes); each item is a `///` block (3 slashes) with an explicit `///` close. Item bodies are full Markdown and may contain other components. Use the `:::wa-accordion … :::` alternative form if you prefer.

**Container tokens** (bare, order-independent, rightmost-wins):
- **appearance**: outlined (default), filled, filled-outlined, plain
- **mode**: multiple (default — several open at once), single (one open at a time, one always stays open), single-collapsible (one open at a time, all can be closed)
- **icon-placement**: end (default), start
- **heading:N**: semantic heading level for item headers — `1`–`6` or `none` (e.g., `heading:2`)

**Item tokens** (leading, on the `///` header line):
- **expanded**: this section starts open on load
- **disabled**: this section renders but cannot be toggled
- **icon:name**: custom expand icon for this item, inserted as its first child (e.g., `icon:star`)
- The rest of the header line becomes the item label (plain text)

`wa-accordion` is experimental in Web Awesome, but everything here is declarative and static-site-safe.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Modal dialog with trigger button
components.documentation:
Modal dialog component. Use >>> to separate trigger button text from dialog content.

Parameters:
- **light-dismiss**: Close when clicking outside
- **width**: Custom width (e.g., 600px, 50vw)

components.name: Tab Group
parameters: disabled (per-tab, leading token on the +++ item header)
components.description: Tabbed content interface with configurable behavior
components.example:
++++++top manual
+++ Tab 1
Content 1
+++
+++ disabled Coming soon
Not yet available.
+++
++++++
components.documentation:
Create tabbed content sections. Use +++ with tab title to define each tab.

Placements: top (default), bottom, start, end
Activation: auto (default, switch on hover), manual (switch on click)
Active: Specify active panel name (e.g., 'tab-1', 'tab-2')
Flags:
- **no-scroll-controls**: Disable scroll arrows for overflowing tabs

**Per-tab flag** (leading token on the `+++ ` item header):
- **disabled**: the tab renders but cannot be selected (e.g., `+++ disabled Coming soon`)

components.name: Tag
components.altSyntax: :::wa-tag variant? appearance? size? pill? with-remove? icon:name?
components.description: Colored label or tag with multiple styles and sizes
components.documentation:
Small colored labels for categorization or status.

Variants: brand, success, neutral, warning, danger
Appearances: accent, filled, outlined, filled-outlined
Sizes: `xs`, `s`, `m`, `l`, `xl` (Web Awesome 3.x scale) plus legacy `small`, `medium`, `large`
Flags:
- **pill**: Rounded edges
- **with-remove**: Removable tag with remove button

**Icons:** Use `icon:name` to add an icon inside the tag (e.g., `icon:check`, `icon:star`)

All parameters are optional and can be combined in any order.

components.name: Copy Button
components.primarySyntax: <<<placement? tooltip:full|copy|none? duration? disabled? copy-label? success-label? error-label? from?
components.altSyntax: :::wa-copy-button placement? tooltip:full|copy|none? duration? disabled? copy-label? success-label? error-label? from?
components.description: Button that copies content to clipboard
components.documentation:
Creates a button that copies the content to clipboard when clicked. Supports markdown formatting in display while preserving raw text for copying.

**Tooltip placement:** top (default), right, bottom, left
**Tooltip mode:** full (default — hover/focus + copy feedback) / copy (feedback only) / none (no tooltip)
**Feedback duration:** a bare number sets the success-message duration in milliseconds (e.g., `2000`)
**Custom labels:** `copy-label="…"`, `success-label="…"`, `error-label="…"`
**Copy from another element:** `from="element-id"` (also supports `from="input.value"`, `from="link[href]"`)
**Flags:** `disabled`

All parameters are optional and combine in any order.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small badge component with variants, appearances, and animations
components.documentation:
Small badge indicators for status or counts.

Variants: brand, success, neutral, warning, danger
Appearances: accent, filled, outlined, filled-outlined
Attention: none, pulse, bounce
Flags: pill (rounded edges)

All parameters are optional and can be combined in any order.

components.name: Button
components.primarySyntax: %%%variant? appearance? size? pill? caret? loading? disabled? target? download? icon:name? icon:end:name?
components.altSyntax: :::wa-button variant? appearance? size? pill? caret? loading? disabled? target? download? icon:name? icon:end:name?
components.description: Button component with optional link, multiple styles and states
components.documentation:
Styled button component. Include a markdown link to make it clickable, or use plain text for a non-link button.

Variants: brand, success, neutral, warning, danger
Appearances: accent, filled, outlined, filled-outlined, plain
Sizes: `xs`, `s`, `m`, `l`, `xl` (Web Awesome 3.x scale) plus legacy `small`, `medium`, `large`
Flags:
- **pill**: Rounded edges
- **caret**: Dropdown indicator
- **loading**: Loading state
- **disabled**: Disabled state

**Link targets (link-form buttons only):** `_blank`, `_self`, `_parent`, `_top` set the anchor target; `_blank` also auto-adds `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. `download` makes the link download its target instead of navigating (e.g., `%%%neutral download\n[Get file](/files/sample.txt)\n%%%`).

**Icons:** Use `icon:name` for start icon, `icon:end:name` for end icon, or both (e.g., `icon:start:gear icon:end:arrow-right`)

All parameters are optional and can be combined in any order.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Floating popover content attached to a trigger element
components.example:
&&&bottom-start
Hover for info
>>>
Popover content with **markdown** support.
&&&
components.inlineExample: Click &&&here >>> This is a popover!&&& to learn more.
components.documentation:
Floating popover attached to a trigger element. Use >>> to separate trigger text from popover content.

**Block syntax** (multi-line):
```
&&&bottom-start
Trigger text
>>>
Popover content
&&&
```

**Inline syntax** (within a sentence):
```
Click &&&here >>> popover content&&& to continue.
```

Placements: top (default), bottom, left, right, plus the eight aligned variants (top-start, top-end, right-start, right-end, bottom-start, bottom-end, left-start, left-end)
Parameters:
- **link**: Render trigger as a link-styled element instead of a button
- **without-arrow**: Hide the popover arrow
- **distance:N**: Offset away from the trigger in px (e.g., distance:10)
- **skidding:N**: Offset along the trigger in px; may be negative (e.g., skidding:12, skidding:-4)

**Inline features:**
- Inline code in trigger text: `&&&\`code\` trigger >>> content&&&`
- Line breaks in popover content using `\n`: `&&&trigger >>> line 1\nline 2&&&`

All parameters are optional and can be combined in any order.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Inline contextual help shown on hover or focus — ideal for glossary terms and inline definitions
components.inlineExample: Styled with (((CSS >>> Cascading Style Sheets))) on the web.
components.documentation:
Inline contextual help shown on hover or focus. The anchor term is rendered as a focusable, dotted-underlined span; the tip appears in a `` wired to it automatically via a generated `for`/`id` pair. Declarative and zero-JavaScript. **Inline syntax** (primary, within a sentence): ``` Styling is handled by (((CSS >>> Cascading Style Sheets))) on the web. ``` **Block syntax** (alternative): ``` :::wa-tooltip bottom-start CSS >>> Cascading Style Sheets ::: ``` Placements: top (default), bottom, left, right, plus the eight aligned variants (top-start, top-end, right-start, right-end, bottom-start, bottom-end, left-start, left-end) Parameters: - **distance:N**: Offset away from the anchor in px (e.g., distance:10) - **skidding:N**: Offset along the anchor in px; may be negative (e.g., skidding:12, skidding:-4) **Tip content** is plain text (HTML-escaped). Use `\n` for line breaks (rendered as `
`): `(((Org number >>> NO: 9 digits\nSE: 10 digits)))`. Leading `placement`/`distance:N`/`skidding:N` tokens go before the anchor term. Unlike popover, there is no `link` or `without-arrow` (Web Awesome `` has no `without-arrow`). All parameters are optional and can be combined in any order.

components.name: Format Date
components.description: Absolute, locale-formatted date baked in at build time (<wa-format-date>)
components.documentation:
Render an absolute, locale-formatted date with `<wa-format-date>`. The date value is baked in at build time; the browser formats it via `Intl.DateTimeFormat`.

**Inline syntax** (primary, within prose):
```
Published [[[2026-06-26 style:long]]].
```

**Block syntax** (alternative):
```
:::wa-format-date 2026-06-26 style:full lang:fr
:::
```

**The date** is an ISO 8601 date (`2026-06-26`) or datetime with a `T` separator (`2026-06-26T14:30:00Z`). Omit it to show the viewer's current time.

**Presets:** `style:short|medium|long|full` and `time:short|medium|long|full` expand to the granular attributes. A bare date defaults to `style:long`; `time:` without a date style emits time-only.

**Granular overrides** (win over presets, rightmost-wins): `weekday`, `era`, `year`, `month`, `day`, `hour`, `minute`, `second` (each an `Intl` value), plus `hour-format:auto|12|24`, `time-zone-name:short|long`, `time-zone:IANA`, and `lang:`/`locale:` for the locale.

Unknown tokens and invalid enum values are silently dropped.

**Static-site note:** like `<wa-icon>`, it renders generated text into shadow DOM with no light-DOM fallback — with Web Awesome's JS disabled it shows nothing.

components.name: Relative Time
components.description: Relative "3 days ago"-style phrase, optionally live-ticking (<wa-relative-time>)
components.documentation:
Render a relative "3 days ago"-style phrase with `<wa-relative-time>`, optionally live-ticking. The browser formats it via `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat`.

**Inline syntax** (primary): prefix the date with `relative`:
```
Updated [[[relative 2026-06-20]]].
```

**Block syntax** (alternative):
```
:::wa-relative-time 2026-06-20 sync
:::
```

**Parameters:**
- **format:long|short|narrow** — phrasing width (default long)
- **numeric:auto|always** — `auto` allows "yesterday"/"tomorrow"; `always` forces "1 day ago" (default auto)
- **sync** — keep the phrase ticking live as time passes
- **lang:**/**locale:** — the locale

Date-formatting tokens (`style:`, `time:`, `month:`, …) are ignored in relative mode.

**Static-site note:** like `<wa-icon>`, it renders generated text into shadow DOM with no light-DOM fallback — with Web Awesome's JS disabled it shows nothing.

components.name: Grid Layout
components.description: Auto-adaptive responsive grid layout. Each child becomes a grid item that wraps responsively.
components.example:
::::grid gap:l min:300px
===accent
# Card 1
Content
===

===accent
# Card 2
Content
===
::::
components.documentation:
Responsive grid that auto-wraps children based on minimum column size. No media queries needed.

**Attributes:**
- **gap:SIZE**: Gap between items (0, 3xs, 2xs, xs, s, m, l, xl, 2xl, 3xl, 4xl, 5xl)
- **min:CSS**: Minimum column size (e.g., `min:300px`, `min:20ch`, `min:15rem`)
- **align:VALUE**: Align items (start, end, center, stretch, baseline)
- **justify:VALUE**: Justify content (start, end, center, space-between, space-around, space-evenly)

Maps to `<div class="wa-grid">` with CSS utility classes.

components.name: Stack Layout
components.description: Vertical spacing between blocks for consistent content rhythm.
components.documentation:
Vertical stack with consistent spacing between child elements.

**Attributes:**
- **gap:SIZE**: Gap between items (0, 3xs, 2xs, xs, s, m, l, xl, 2xl, 3xl, 4xl, 5xl)
- **align:VALUE**: Align items (start, end, center, stretch, baseline)
- **justify:VALUE**: Justify content (start, end, center, space-between, space-around, space-evenly)

Maps to `<div class="wa-stack">` with CSS utility classes.

components.name: Cluster Layout
components.description: Inline wrapping items. Great for tag clouds, button rows, icon lists.
components.documentation:
Horizontal cluster that wraps items inline. Perfect for tag clouds, button groups, and icon rows.

**Attributes:**
- **gap:SIZE**: Gap between items (0, 3xs, 2xs, xs, s, m, l, xl, 2xl, 3xl, 4xl, 5xl)
- **align:VALUE**: Align items (start, end, center, stretch, baseline)
- **justify:VALUE**: Justify content (start, end, center, space-between, space-around, space-evenly)

Maps to `<div class="wa-cluster">` with CSS utility classes.

components.name: Split Layout
components.description: Distribute items to opposite ends. Classic header/footer pattern.
components.documentation:
Splits children to opposite ends of a row (or column). Perfect for headers, footers, and navigation bars.

**Attributes:**
- **row**: Horizontal split (default)
- **column**: Vertical split
- **gap:SIZE**: Gap between items (0, 3xs, 2xs, xs, s, m, l, xl, 2xl, 3xl, 4xl, 5xl)
- **align:VALUE**: Align items (start, end, center, stretch, baseline)
- **justify:VALUE**: Justify content (start, end, center, space-between, space-around, space-evenly)

Maps to `<div class="wa-split">` with CSS utility classes.

components.name: Flank Layout
components.description: Sidebar + main content. One item flanks the other, wrapping on small screens.
components.example:
::::flank start size:200px gap:l
![Photo](photo.jpg)

## Main Content
Content here.
::::
components.documentation:
Sidebar layout where one item flanks the main content, wrapping responsively on small screens.

**Attributes:**
- **start**: Flanking item on the start side (default)
- **end**: Flanking item on the end side
- **size:CSS**: Flanking item size (e.g., `size:200px`, `size:15rem`)
- **content:PCT**: Minimum content percentage (e.g., `content:70%`)
- **gap:SIZE**: Gap between items (0, 3xs, 2xs, xs, s, m, l, xl, 2xl, 3xl, 4xl, 5xl)
- **align:VALUE**: Align items (start, end, center, stretch, baseline)
- **justify:VALUE**: Justify content (start, end, center, space-between, space-around, space-evenly)

Maps to `<div class="wa-flank">` with CSS utility classes.

components.name: Frame Layout
components.description: Aspect-ratio container for images and media.
components.documentation:
Constrains content to a specific aspect ratio. Ideal for images, videos, and media containers. **Attributes:** - **landscape**: 16:9 aspect ratio - **portrait**: 9:16 aspect ratio - **square**: 1:1 aspect ratio - **radius:SIZE**: Border radius (s, m, l, pill, circle, square) - **gap:SIZE**: Gap between items (0, 3xs, 2xs, xs, s, m, l, xl, 2xl, 3xl, 4xl, 5xl) - **align:VALUE**: Align items (start, end, center, stretch, baseline) - **justify:VALUE**: Justify content (start, end, center, space-between, space-around, space-evenly) Maps to `
` with CSS utility classes. **Note:** Use `` HTML tags directly inside frames, as Markdown image syntax may not be processed inside layout containers.
